SELECT C.PROGRM_ID, C.UNT_SYS_SE_CD, (SELECT E.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ WHERE TO_CHAR(E.MENU_NO) = C.UNT_SYS_SE_CD) AS UP_MENU_NM, C.PROGRM_NM, C.OUTSD_PROGRM_YN, C.URL_ADDR, C.PROGRM_USE_SE_CD, C.RM_CN, C.ATFINO, /* (SELECT REAL_FILE_NM FROM SAB821 E WHERE C.ATFINO = E.ATFINO AND FILE_STTS_SE_CD != 'D') AS ATCMFL_NM, */ C.ATCMFL_NM, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT

LEFT JOIN SAB200 D ON TO_CHAR(D.MENU_NO) = C.UNT_SYS_SE_CD
